name.zh: 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第六门 布林克克

location.zh: 精灵太空站 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第六门

reward_note: Each door boss, when beaten, gave its 暗黑精灵's 精元 (4399 2010-06-04: 通关后获得精元), hatching the line's first stage.

capture.zh: 暗黑武斗场暗黑第六门：100级布林克克，约2000血。打败获得布林克克精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 谱尼圣堂之门消强后攻击；2010年玩家多用魔焰猩猩绝命火焰，或鲁斯王+盖亚消强+丽莎收尾。

engine_notes: Entry (original): 超能NoNo owners loaded the 反物质芯片 directly; others needed NoNo AI level 10 and a crafted 反物质芯片 (VIP-gated). Doors open in order: 试炼之门, then 暗黑第一门 … 第九门 (pre-2013). The remake drops the VIP gate.
heal_full_below: 4399 2011: 血量低于200自动回满; 4399 2010-06: 血少于100的时候会回满血. 200 used (later, more specific source).
immune_status_list: '免疫多种异常状态' without a list; the listed set is an assumption.
Innate boost, high attack and speed (天生携带强化效果，高攻高速); atk+2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19). Level not published (等级未知), 100 assumed.
寄生种子 has no effect, like 烧伤, 冻伤 and 中毒 (4399 2011-05-26). The wiki's 技能无限 is a broken template: PP stays finite.
source_note: 4399 第六门攻略: No.359 水系 HP2000, heals to full when low.
